issues.title: Drag-able Color Pin
issues.body:
I was creating the wargame for issue #1400 and I noticed that when selecting the Force color, the color pin can't be dragged around in the color chart: 

https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/85491794/157916710-25e0d1d2-c428-458e-bcc8-e8ba1cf6c609.mp4

As you can see, I can only select a color by clicking on an area in the color chart. It would be better if the user could drag the color pin and view the preview on the icon color box. That would give them more and better control of their color choice (that, for a wargame with lots of different Force color nuances, is very important).
